hook.say: The ten largest deserts on Earth, ranked. The top two have no sand at all!

outro.say: Did you expect the Sahara? Comment below!

items.name: Great Basin
items.say: Number ten: Great Basin, the largest desert in the USA. 492,000 square kilometers.
items.cap: Number ten: Great Basin, the largest desert in the USA. 492,000 square kilometers.

items.name: Syrian Desert
items.say: Nine: Syrian Desert, crossed by ancient caravan routes. 500,000.
items.cap: Nine: Syrian Desert, crossed by ancient caravan routes. 500,000.

items.name: Patagonian
items.say: Eight: Patagonian, the largest in the Americas. 673,000.
items.cap: Eight: Patagonian, the largest in the Americas. 673,000.

items.name: Kalahari
items.say: Seven: Kalahari, home of the meerkats. 900,000.
items.cap: Seven: Kalahari, home of the meerkats. 900,000.

items.name: Gobi
items.say: Six: Gobi, where the first dinosaur eggs were found. One-point-three million.
items.cap: Six: Gobi, where the first dinosaur eggs were found. 1.3 million.

items.name: Great Australian
items.say: Five: Great Australian, several deserts counted as one. One-point-four million.
items.cap: Five: Great Australian, several deserts counted as one. 1.4 million.

items.name: Arabian
items.say: Four: Arabian, with the largest sand sea on Earth. Two-point-three million.
items.cap: Four: Arabian, with the largest sand sea on Earth. 2.3 million.

items.name: Sahara
items.fact: Almost the size of the USA
items.say: Three: Sahara, almost the size of the USA. Nine-point-two million.
items.cap: Three: Sahara, almost the size of the USA. 9.2 million.

items.name: Arctic
items.say: Two: Arctic, made of ice and tundra. Thirteen-point-nine million.
items.cap: Two: Arctic, made of ice and tundra. 13.9 million.

items.name: Antarctic
items.say: And number one: Antarctica! Fourteen-point-two million square kilometers, the driest continent on Earth.
items.cap: And number one: Antarctica! 14.2 million square kilometers, the driest continent on Earth.
